title: 英文迷你卷：到期錯題改寫（8/24）
subject: 英文

questions.stem: The clerk will ______ the parcel before calculating the postage.
questions.explain: weigh 表示秤重；wait 表示等待。包裹在計算郵資前應先秤重。

questions.stem: Please ______ me to bring the proof of payment tomorrow.
questions.explain: remind someone to do something 表示提醒某人做某事；recall 是回想。

questions.stem: The new tracking service is now ______ to customers nationwide.
questions.explain: be available to 表示可供某人使用；reachable 著重能夠到達或聯絡。

questions.stem: This procedure is ______ to the one we followed last year.
questions.explain: be similar to 表示與……相似；familiar 通常用 be familiar with。

questions.stem: The ______ of the annual report was delayed for two weeks.
questions.explain: 定冠詞 The 後需要名詞；publication 表示出版或出版物。publisher 是出版者。

questions.stem: Be ______ when entering the account number, because one wrong digit may delay the transfer.
questions.explain: be 後接形容詞，且語意為輸入帳號時應小心，故用 careful。

questions.stem: Customers may apply for ______ when an insured parcel is lost.
questions.explain: compensation 表示補償；competition 是競爭，composition 是作文或組成，comprehension 是理解。

questions.stem: Your magazine ______ will expire at the end of this month.
questions.explain: subscription 表示訂閱；submission 是提交，subsidy 是補助。

questions.stem: Applicants must attach ______ before requesting a refund.
questions.explain: proof of payment 是付款證明的固定用語；proof 作證明之意時常作不可數名詞。

questions.stem: The manager ______ the customer that the parcel would be traced immediately.
questions.explain: assure someone that... 表示向某人保證；ensure 後通常直接接受確保之事。

questions.stem: All registered items must ______ before they leave the office.
questions.explain: 郵件是被掃描，must 後用被動不定詞 be scanned。

questions.stem: ______ by heavy rain, several deliveries arrived late.
questions.explain: deliveries 與 delay 為被動關係，分詞構句用過去分詞 Delayed。

questions.stem: I wish the post office ______ open later on weekdays.
questions.explain: wish 表示與現在事實相反的願望時，後接過去式。

questions.stem: The clerk must verify the identity ______ the customer is in a hurry.
questions.explain: 語意是即使顧客趕時間仍須核對身分，需用讓步連接詞 even if。

questions.stem: The village ______ the mobile post office stops has no bank branch.
questions.explain: 先行詞是地點，關係詞在子句中作地點副詞，故用 where。

questions.stem: The service ______ was introduced last month has reduced waiting time.
questions.explain: 先行詞 service 是物，關係詞在子句中作主詞，故用 which。

questions.stem: The parcel was correctly addressed; ______, it was sent to the wrong office.
questions.explain: 前後語意相反，應用 however 表示轉折；therefore 表示結果。

questions.stem: The road was closed, ______ the delivery vehicle had to take another route.
questions.explain: 道路封閉造成車輛改道，後句是結果，故用 so。

questions.stem: The clerk checked ______ the address had been written correctly.
questions.explain: check whether... 表示確認是否……，whether 引導名詞子句。

questions.stem: A notice states: 'The counter closes at 5 p.m., but parcels placed in the lobby box before 6 p.m. will still be collected today.' Which statement is correct?
options: No parcel is collected after 5 p.m.
A parcel posted in the lobby box at 5:30 p.m. is collected today.
The lobby box is available only before 5 p.m.
questions.explain: 公告明示大廳郵筒在下午六時前投入仍會當日收取；櫃檯關閉時間仍是下午五時。

questions.stem: A short report explains that rural post offices remain open despite low profits because residents rely on them for cash withdrawals, bill payments, and savings. What is the main idea?
options: Rural branches earn the highest profits.
Postal services support financial access in rural areas.
Residents prefer paying every bill in cash.
Commercial banks are required to serve every village.
questions.explain: 全文重點是鄉村郵局提供基本金融服務、維持金融可近性；低獲利只是背景。
